title: Senior Associate – Energy
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate – Energy** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant* 
***post MBA***
*experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm known for solving complex business challenges and delivering measurable results. Our teams work with organizations facing transformation, performance, restructuring, and growth priorities where practical execution matters as much as strategic direction. The firm brings together industry expertise, analytical rigor, and hands\-on leadership to help clients improve performance and build lasting value. In India, our professionals collaborate across sectors and capabilities to address high\-impact business problems for leading organizations. The Energy practice advises clients across the energy value chain, including oil and gas, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities. We value professionals who combine structured problem\-solving with commercial judgment, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and take ownership for outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to work on challenging engagements, contribute to business development, and help shape solutions that influence critical decisions across the Energy sector.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Senior Associate will own high\-impact workstreams for Energy\-sector clients, combining deep sub\-sector expertise with adaptable advisory skills across adjacent markets. The role will diagnose performance, strategy, restructuring, and operational challenges; convert analysis into clear recommendations; and support implementation that improves value, resilience, and execution. You will work across O\&G upstream and downstream, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities, with the expectation of developing a differentiated point of view in at least one sub\-sector. Success requires strong ownership of analyses, client\-ready communication, team leadership, and the judgment to connect operational levers with financial and strategic impact. Based in Gurgaon and working onsite, you will collaborate closely with senior professionals and client teams on complex, time\-sensitive engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end workstreams across Energy consulting engagements, structuring ambiguous problems, defining analyses, and converting findings into decisions that improve client performance and enterprise value.
* Lead market, operational, financial, and strategic analyses using structured problem\-solving, data, and business judgment to identify root causes and prioritize value\-creation opportunities.
* Develop actionable recommendations for strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, and operational transformation, linking each initiative to measurable commercial or operating outcomes.
* Manage client interactions and senior stakeholder communication, presenting concise insights, challenging assumptions constructively, and building alignment around implementation priorities and ownership.
* Guide analysts and associates through problem definition, quality assurance, synthesis, and delivery, raising team capability while maintaining high standards for accuracy, pace, and clarity.
* Contribute to proposals, business development, and knowledge building by applying Energy\-sector expertise to shape differentiated perspectives, compelling solutions, and repeatable intellectual capital.
* Adapt across adjacent Energy sub\-sectors while maintaining deep expertise in at least one area, ensuring recommendations reflect sector economics, operating realities, and relevant value drivers.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Deep expertise in at least one Energy sub\-sector, such as O\&G upstream or downstream, chemicals, mining, power, or utilities, with the ability to transfer insights across adjacent markets.
* Strong experience in consulting, advisory, or relevant industry roles spanning strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting, with ownership of complex workstreams.
* Advanced problem\-solving, financial and operational analysis, executive communication, and stakeholder\-management skills, supported by strong proficiency in standard analytical and presentation tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering implementation programs or transformation initiatives where recommendations were translated into operating changes, performance gains, or measurable financial improvement.
* Exposure to multiple Energy sub\-sectors, market situations, or geographies, enabling faster pattern recognition and more relevant recommendations for complex client contexts.
* Demonstrated contribution to proposals, client development, thought leadership, or internal capability building that strengthens the practice and creates new commercial opportunities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–8 years of total professional experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience, gained in consulting, advisory, or relevant Energy industry roles.
* A strong academic foundation, including an MBA or related postgraduate qualification, with the commercial maturity to engage senior client stakeholders and influence important decisions.
* Demonstrated depth in at least one Energy sub\-sector and the adaptability to work credibly across O\&G, chemicals, mining, power, and utilities as client priorities require.
* A record of owning analytical and problem\-solving workstreams across strategy, restructuring, performance improvement, analytics, or operational consulting engagements.
* The ability to move from data and diagnosis to practical recommendations, implementation priorities, and measurable business impact without losing attention to detail.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the confidence to synthesize complex issues for executives and facilitate productive discussions with diverse stakeholders.
* A collaborative leadership style that develops junior team members, improves quality, and maintains momentum in fast\-paced, high\-expectation environments.
* Willingness to work onsite in Gurgaon and contribute actively to a team culture built around accountability, intellectual rigor, and hands\-on delivery.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Work on consequential Energy\-sector challenges where your analyses directly influence strategy, performance, restructuring, and investment decisions. You will see recommendations move from diagnosis into implementation and measurable client outcomes.
* Build differentiated expertise across a broad Energy landscape while developing depth in a chosen sub\-sector. The role offers exposure to senior stakeholders, complex situations, and adjacent industries that accelerate commercial judgment.
* Join a performance\-oriented team that values practical problem solving, clear communication, and ownership. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who expect high standards and support meaningful professional growth.
* Contribute beyond individual engagements through proposals, knowledge building, and practice development. Your perspectives can shape how the firm addresses evolving Energy\-sector priorities and creates value for future clients.



  





**What We Offer** 



* The opportunity to work on high\-impact Energy engagements spanning strategy, performance improvement, restructuring, analytics, and operational transformation across leading industry segments.
* A platform for accelerated learning through direct client exposure, cross\-sector problem solving, senior mentorship, and responsibility for workstreams with visible business impact.
* A collaborative, onsite Gurgaon environment with strong expectations for ownership, analytical rigor, practical execution, and contribution to the growth of the Energy advisory practice.

 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| Bengaluru
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst in BCG X Product Delivery, you will support the delivery of projects and digital solutions for clients across the oil \& gas, refining, chemicals, and broader energy value chain. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, operations, and technology, helping clients translate complex operational challenges into practical, high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 You will help structure client problems, identify value pools, define improvement opportunities, and support the design of use cases across areas such as refining performance, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, emissions reduction, turnaround management, maintenance, reliability, and operational excellence.
   

  

 You will work closely with BCG case teams, BCG X product and technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure that Ekons solutions are grounded in real business needs. You will support client interviews, workshops, diagnostics, value sizing, business case development, roadmap definition, and change management activities.
   

  

 You will also help translate strategic and operational priorities into clear solution requirements, ensuring that digital tools are not developed in isolation but are directly linked to measurable business outcomes. Over time, you will contribute to building reusable assets, industry perspectives, commercial materials, and delivery playbooks for Ekons.
   

  

**You Are Good At**
* Structuring complex and ambiguous oil \& gas business problems into clear hypotheses, value opportunities, workplans, and executive\-ready recommendations.
* Leading client\-facing problem solving across oil \& gas, refining, chemicals, energy, and asset\-intensive operations topics.
* Engaging senior client stakeholders, BCG case teams, and technical teams to align priorities, decisions, trade\-offs, and next steps.
* Translating operational challenges into digital solution requirements, ensuring use cases are linked to tangible business value.
* Identifying and sizing value pools across areas such as margin optimization, planning and scheduling, maintenance, reliability, emissions, operational excellence, and performance management.
* Synthesizing complex analyses, interviews, workshops, and technical inputs into clear storylines, decision materials, and implementation roadmaps.
* Coaching junior team members and coordinating multidisciplinary teams to deliver high\-quality work in fast\-paced client environments.


 \#BCGXjob
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 7–9 years of relevant experience in consulting, oil \& gas, energy, refining, chemicals, industrial goods, operations, digital transformation, or performance improvement required; candidates with top\-tier strategy consulting experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading client\-facing workstreams, managing senior stakeholders, developing executive\-ready materials, and translating complex business problems into actionable recommendations.
* Strong energy sector experience, ideally across areas such as refining economics, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, maintenance, reliability, emissions, operational excellence, or asset performance.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree in engineering, business, economics, energy, operations, or related field preferred.
* Strong business acumen, analytical rigor, communication skills, and leadership maturity, with the ability to connect industry expertise, digital solutions, and measurable business impact.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Client, Case, \& Knowledge team members
* Product Engineering, Product Management, and Infrastructure Support team

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Job Title:\- Manager \- Strategic Buyer (L09\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 This role is in the Procurement within Source to Pay (S2P) organization in Synchrony. Source to Pay team provides centralized supplier procurement, contracting, \& ongoing management support across all Synchrony Functions delivering those products and services needed to be successful in our daily operations.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The Strategic Buyer plays a critical role in Synchrony’s procurement transformation by owning end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories within the Global Procurement Buy Desk and Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) function. The role ensures purchases are routed through the optimal buying channel—including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and guided buying through Coupa Smart Intake—while driving compliant purchasing, PO lifecycle discipline, tail spend optimization, integration issue resolution, and digital enablement through Coupa, Oracle, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end buying for assigned categories and route demand through the right buying channel, including catalogue, contract, spot buy, and Coupa Smart Intake guided buying.
* Execute purchase transactions within defined SLAs while ensuring policy compliance, PO accuracy, and Contract\-to\-PO alignment.
* Partner with Source\-to\-Pay, category managers, Bid Desk, Finance, requesters, and suppliers to support buying strategy execution and resolve L1/L2 procurement queries.
* Manage PO lifecycle activities, including requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, issue triage, and PO hygiene to support audit readiness and reliable reporting.
* Drive spend analytics, including tail spend, buying channel, supplier, category, PO, receipt, and spend cube analysis to identify consolidation, compliance, and optimization opportunities.
* Monitor Coupa–Oracle integration issues, including inactive supplier sites, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt discrepancies, and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Support dashboards and KPI reporting using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, Excel, and related tools to improve operational visibility and decision\-making.
* Enable AI\-led procurement transformation by leveraging Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio for intake classification, requisition routing, workflow automation, UAT/SIT support, and use\-case development.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4\-5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or 6\-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end buying activities across assigned categories and route purchases through appropriate buying channels.
* Strong understanding of Source\-to\-Pay, Procure\-to\-Pay, Coupa Smart Intake, catalogue buying, contract buying, spot buying, and guided buying processes.
* Proven capability in PO lifecycle management, requisition workflow tracking, PO modifications, Contract\-to\-PO alignment, catalogue enablement, and PO hygiene.
* Strong analytical skills to conduct tail spend, buying channel, spend cube, PO, and receipt data analysis using Coupa, Oracle, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to manage L1 and L2 procurement helpdesk queries, coordinate with Bid Desk, Finance, Source\-to\-Pay, and category teams, and escalate critical issues appropriately.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Experience supporting procurement transformation, channel management, tail spend reduction, and unmanaged spend compliance initiatives.
* Working knowledge of Coupa–Oracle integration touchpoints, including supplier site, GL, PAR number, PO, and receipt\-related issue resolution.
* Comfort using Coupa Analytics, Power BI, dashboards, and reporting tools to monitor operational KPIs and support decision\-making.
* Awareness of AI\-enabled procurement capabilities, including Coupa AI Agents and Coupa Agentic Studio, Process Transformation with willingness to develop practical use cases and assist in Process Intelligence initiatives.
* Experience participating in UAT, SIT, pressure testing, process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline 4 \- 5 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred or in lieu of a degree 6 \-7 years of procurement or supply chain operations experience; Source\-to\-Pay / Procure\-to\-Pay environment strongly preferred.


**Work Timings: 04:00 PM – 01:00 AM IST**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. * Coordinate approvals and periodic reviews — manage governance processes end\-to\-end,ensuring timely approvals, structured review cycles, and accurate documentation
* Support end\-to\-end policy lifecycle management and reporting — oversee the full lifecycleof policies from inception through to retirement, maintaining high\-quality records andproducing meaningful governance reporting

* Contribute to continuous improvement — proactively identify opportunities to enhancepolicy governance processes, frameworks, and tools in a dynamic and evolving riskenvironment

 The ORM Policy Governance team sits within Group Functions Risk Management (GFRM) at SwissRe. The team is responsible for building and maintaining a central 2LoD policy governancecapability for selected operational risks, working across the organisation to ensure that policyrequirements are clear, robust, and fit for purpose. The team collaborates closely with first lineteams and subject matter experts to promote consistent, sustainable governance across a broadrange of evolving operational risk topics — from AI and Data Management to RecordsManagement and beyond.
   

  

**About You**
 You are a detail\-oriented, collaborative, and proactive professional with a genuine interest inoperational risk governance and policy design. You bring strong analytical and communicationskills, a structured working style, and the confidence to engage and challenge constructivelyacross all levels of the organisation. You are comfortable navigating complexity, managingmultiple priorities, and contributing meaningfully to a team that values knowledge sharing,curiosity, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in Operational risk management expertise — relevant experience in operational riskmanagement, financial or non\-financial risk governance, or a comparablecontrol/governance environment within insurance or financial services
* Policy governance experience — demonstrated experience in policy drafting, policy review,governance processes, or lifecycle management, with a strong ability to write clear,concise, and practical policy requirements
* Understanding of the three lines of defence model — solid grasp of operational riskmanagement concepts and governance frameworks, with the ability to apply soundjudgement on governance matters
* Academic foundation — university degree in business, finance, law, risk management, or arelated field (or equivalent studies)
* Communication and stakeholder engagement skills — strong written and verbalcommunication skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively with technical andnon\-technical stakeholders and challenge constructively


**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**
* Experience working in a second line of defence or oversight function within a large, complexorganisation
* Familiarity with evolving operational risk topics such as AI governance, data management,or records management
* Experience working in a multinational or cross\-cultural environment
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail and the ability to manage multipletopics and deadlines simultaneously
* A collaborative mindset with a passion for knowledge sharing and continuous improvement
* Ability to switch fluidly between detailed analytical work and strategic, big\-picture thinking


 Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office atleast three days per week.
   

  

**About Swiss Re**
 Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance\-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property \& Casualty and Life \& Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting\-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. title: Data and AI Security Consultant
description:
**Overview**
 The EAG Security Consultant \- Data Security helps enterprise customers discover, classify, protect, govern, and investigate sensitive data across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, endpoints, cloud services, and AI\-enabled workflows. The role combines hands\-on Purview delivery, consulting judgment, regulatory awareness, and secure AI adoption patterns to reduce data exposure risk, strengthen DLP effectiveness, prepare customers for Copilot and agents, and create reusable EAG Security delivery IP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead data security discovery workshops to understand sensitive data landscape, regulatory drivers, current Purview adoption, oversharing risks, and AI / Copilot readiness blockers.
* Design and implement Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto\-labeling patterns, and user adoption controls.
* Configure, tune, and operationalize Data Loss Prevention across Microsoft 365 workloads, endpoints, cloud apps, browsers, and AI\-related workflows where applicable.
* Assess Insider Risk Management, eDiscovery, Audit, Data Lifecycle Management, and Compliance Manager usage to improve investigation readiness and governance maturity.
* Apply DSPM and data\-security\-for\-AI patterns to identify overshared sensitive data, label coverage gaps, exposed credentials, and risky data interactions before AI rollout.
* Support Data Protection Agents and Purview agent scenarios such as sensitive data discovery, SIT recommendation, DLP triage, Purview posture assessment, and regulatory mapping.
* Create executive\-ready deliverables including posture baselines, risk registers, remediation roadmaps, policy design packs, operating procedures, and adoption recommendations.
* Contribute reusable EAG Security IP, lab guides, demos, accelerators, playbooks, and enablement content for data security delivery at scale.


**Qualifications**
 Required/Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information protection, data loss prevention, compliance engineering, data governance, or related security consulting roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Purview data security capabilities, especially Information Protection and Data Loss Prevention in Microsoft 365 environments.
* Working knowledge of sensitive information types, classification strategies, sensitivity labels, DLP rules, alert triage, policy tuning, and exception handling.
* Ability to translate regulatory, privacy, and business requirements into implementable Microsoft Purview controls and customer\-facing design documentation.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 security and compliance workloads including Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, endpoints, Defender for Cloud Apps, audit and eDiscovery signals.
* Ability to analyze policy exports, telemetry, PowerShell outputs, and Purview reports to identify coverage gaps and remediation priorities.
* Strong communication skills for technical workshops, executive readouts, project governance, and cross\-functional collaboration with security, compliance, legal, and data teams.


**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience delivering Purview deployments for regulated customers across DLP, MIP, IRM, retention, eDiscovery, audit, or Copilot readiness scenarios.
* Exposure to Data Protection Agents, Purview posture assessment, custom SIT discovery, DLP triage agents, DSPM, DSPM for AI, or Security Copilot in Microsoft Purview.
* Ability to design custom sensitive information types, regex\-based detection logic, policy coverage assessments, and evidence\-backed compliance mappings.
* Familiarity with data security beyond Microsoft 365, including Azure, Fabric, Snowflake, Dataverse, SAP, Salesforce, AWS, GCP, SaaS, or file\-server governance patterns.
* Experience creating reusable consulting IP such as discovery questionnaires, policy design templates, lab guides, dashboards, scripts, reports, and executive summaries.

You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
   

  

 The
 **Citi Advantage Cobrand Acquisitions Risk \& Controls Lead** 
 is responsible for building, maintaining, and executing a robust control framework across Cobrand Partner channels and Partner\-Generated Campaigns. This pivotal role drives the "Operating in Control" (OIC) agenda for the Cobrand portfolio, providing comprehensive oversight of issues and escalations, coordinating internal and external exams, and managing the end\-to\-end lifecycle of the Process, Risk, Control, and Monitoring (PRCM) framework—from initial design to annual assessments and ongoing monitoring. Additionally, the Lead owns the end\-to\-end authorship and maintenance of the Cobrand Desktop Manual, a critical cornerstone of OIC documentation.
   

  

 Ultimately, this individual ensures that Cobrand operates in a highly controlled environment across both existing and emerging channels and products. Proactive oversight is critical; without it, channels risk falling short of management expectations across the Cobrand partner portfolios. With aggressive partner commitments and channel growth plans slated for 2026 and beyond, this role serves as the epicenter of our control framework. Success requires cultivating deep, collaborative partnerships with key internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, including In\-Business Control, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Product/Marketing owners. A rapid onboarding and deep understanding of the Marketing Organization’s operational dynamics are essential for immediate impact.
   

  

**In this role, you’re expected to:**
* Serve as Operating in Control (OIC) Co\-Champion for Cobrand Acquisitions, establishing clear accountability and streamlined processes across key pillars: Issues Management, Exam Support/Coordination, PRCM/Control Maintenance, and Desktop Manual ownership.
* Rapidly master the marketing and acquisition business model to effectively understand, articulate, and influence critical points of intersection with the OIC agenda.
* Champion and elevate risk and control standards, ensuring their consistent, equitable application while exercising sound, long\-term risk judgment.
* Implement and execute robust risk and control practices across the Marketing \& Franchise Development organization, embedding proactive foresight, risk anticipation, and preventative control solutions.
* Deliver on Citi’s regulatory transformation commitments, driving process and control excellence to achieve frictionless execution and radical simplification.
* Cultivate proactive risk management practices across the broader team, championing a best\-in\-class risk and controls culture.
* Maintain a perpetual state of audit and exam readiness; deliver high\-quality walkthroughs and artifacts to reviewers, while prioritizing and executing against regulatory commitments, including Consent Order requirements.
* Escalate and permanently resolve identified issues in a timely manner, ensuring full compliance with organizational expectations and enterprise procedures.
* Deliver compliant, safe, and customer\-centric operational excellence through the rigorous design of business processes and the flawless execution of day\-to\-day controls.
* Proactively identify control gaps, process deficiencies, approval discrepancies, and compliance risks, driving swift escalation, remediation, and resolution with key stakeholders.
* Lead process improvement, automation, and workflow optimization initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen controls, improve review accuracy, and minimize manual effort.
* Serve as the primary Records Retention Point of Contact (POC) for the Cobrand team, partnering with the Business Records Management Officer to maintain the Cobrand Record Inventory and execute compliance activities.
* Partner with technology teams to implement system enhancements, testing protocols, and process innovations that drive user adoption, operational effectiveness, and control consistency.
* Foster a culture of deep accountability, continuous improvement, and rigorous governance, compliance, and operational excellence within the Cobrand team.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned, supporting the evolving needs of the business.


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
* 8–13 years of experience in Financial Services, with a strong preference for experience in Marketing, Risk, or Control management.
* Proven track record of advanced project management, with exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder\-influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a high\-stakes environment.

title: Conflict and Intake Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Conflicts \& Intake Analyst** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience** 
 : 4\-6 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems and deliver measurable results. The firm values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. A\&M Global Capability Center Private Limited, established in India in 2023, partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across business units and geographies. The center supports end\-to\-end client delivery and thought leadership rather than traditional back\-office work. Its teams serve the Americas, EMEA, and APAC across industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing GCC is already a 1,000\+ member team. It combines consulting and industry expertise with specialized talent, automation, and hybrid delivery models to improve speed, scale, quality, and client value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 The Conflicts \& Intake Analyst owns the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of legal conflict checks and business\-intake records for new clients, matters, and existing engagements. The role uses conflicts databases, Boolean search techniques, structured review, and stakeholder follow\-up to identify related parties, clarify discrepancies, and support ethical risk decisions. Reporting to the Team Manager, you will work with attorneys and business representatives to vet incoming requests, update matter records, and prepare clear reports for review and approval. Your work will protect the firm from conflicts of interest, improve intake quality, and enable teams to pursue new business with confidence. This onsite Gurgaon role requires sound judgment, strong organization, and flexibility for scheduled after\-hours, weekend, and rotational on\-call coverage when business demands require it.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Run timely and accurate conflict searches for preliminary checks, formally submitted new business, new clients, and matters, using database research and Boolean techniques to surface relevant relationships.
* Own daily matter updates by adding new parties, maintaining conflict memos, and ensuring approved client and engagement information remains complete, current, and traceable.
* Vet all requests entering the department, including matter reopenings, new business for existing or new clients, and preliminary checks, resolving missing or inconsistent information before review.
* Evaluate search results and discrepancies methodically, then consolidate findings into clear reports that help attorneys and business stakeholders assess conflicts and manage ethical risk.
* Liaise confidently with attorneys and business representatives by email, telephone, and in person to obtain, clarify, and validate information needed for client and matter intake.
* Prioritize urgent and competing requests in a time\-sensitive environment, maintaining quality, responsiveness, and follow\-through without compromising accuracy or compliance requirements.
* Support the integrity of the conflicts database by applying consistent data standards, documenting updates, and entering general client information after new business approval.
* Participate in scheduled after\-hours or weekend projects and rotational remote on\-call shifts to maintain dependable conflicts support across global teams and deadlines.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Hands\-on experience conducting legal conflict searches, business intake, and conflicts database reviews, with strong attention to detail, accuracy, documentation quality, and ethical risk awareness.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence to engage attorneys and business stakeholders at different levels with clarity, professionalism, and customer\-service orientation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word, plus practical ability to use Boolean search operators and techniques for structured information retrieval.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Prior experience in a law firm, legal department, or professional\-services environment where confidentiality, compliance, and rapid response were essential to daily operations.
* Direct experience with conflicts checking, related\-party research, engagement databases, matter management, or legal business\-intake workflows will help you contribute quickly.
* Familiarity with ABA mandates, conflicts\-of\-interest controls, and ethical risk management is advantageous for evaluating search results and escalating potential concerns appropriately.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Four to six years of experience, including at least three years in a legal, law\-firm, or legal department environment, with conflicts checking or legal intake exposure preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, urgent requests, follow\-ups, and time\-sensitive deadlines while preserving thoroughness, quality, and data integrity.
* A methodical problem\-solving approach that helps you investigate discrepancies, distinguish relevant relationships, and escalate issues with practical recommendations and complete supporting information.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, enabling confident interaction with attorneys, business representatives, and colleagues through email, telephone, and in\-person collaboration.
* Strong organization, ownership, and attention to detail, with the judgment to handle confidential information and the discipline to maintain reliable database records.
* A customer\-service mindset and willingness to support scheduled after\-hours or weekend work and rotational on\-call coverage when global business needs require it.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, Boolean search techniques, and structured database research, combined with genuine commitment to compliance and conflicts\-of\-interest controls.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Join a rapidly scaling India capability center that works alongside global case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, giving legal operations professionals exposure beyond traditional back\-office support.
* Build expertise in conflicts management, ethical risk, and global business intake while collaborating with attorneys and stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.
* Grow in a meritocratic culture that combines entrepreneurial ownership, continuous learning, on\-the\-job development, and meaningful opportunities to expand your professional capabilities.
* Contribute to a firm where integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal reward guide how teams work and how individual impact is recognized.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A structured performance development process, continuous learning, and on\-the\-job training designed to support professional growth and career progression.
* Exposure to global teams, diverse industries, and complex client\-delivery environments within a rapidly growing 1,000\+ member India capability center.
* An entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values independent thinking, meaningful ownership, inclusion, and practical impact.
* Benefits and well\-being resources that support employees’ professional development and personal journey.

We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in AWS cloud services, Amazon EKS, and containerized platforms to design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architect, build, and maintain scalable platform solutions using AWS services with a strong focus on EKS and containerization.
* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK, enabling fully automated and repeatable cloud provisioning.
* Develop and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, leveraging YAML and PowerShell scripting to drive automation.
* Deploy, manage, and optimize workloads across AWS and Azure, including Windows Services and .NET\-based applications.
* Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including secure networking, IAM, secret management, and compliance controls.
* Integrate application and security scanning tools such as Veracode into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous security validation.
* Drive DevOps automation best practices, improving deployment reliability, observability, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with development, security, and architecture teams to streamline delivery workflows and enhance platform reliability.

* Proven experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.
* Expertise in CDK Workflows, CI/CD pipeline engineering using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
* Solid scripting skills in PowerShell and experience authoring YAML\-based workflows.
* Experience deploying and supporting Windows\-based and .NET workloads in cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles, including automated security scanning and compliance.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with multi\-cloud architectures (AWS and Azure).

title: Senior Associate, Software Engineering
description:
BetaNXT
   

  

 The Company
   

  

 BetaNXT is the next wave in wealth management technology and outsourcing solutions. We focused on solving our customers most demanding integration challenges with flexible, efficient, connected solutions. Our products reduce enterprise cost, streamline operation processes, increase advisor productivity, and enhances the investor experience. Together with BetaNXT, wealth management firms are transforming their platforms into differentiating assets that enable scale and commercial growth.
   

  

 But we're not just invested in our customers; we're also invested in people. We know that our overall success is a combined effort, and we therefore strive to provide opportunities for our employees to learn, grow and thrive.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 BETA is a self\-clearing securities processing solution for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands\-on experience, BETA provides critical back\-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
   

  

 We are seeking a Senior Associate with hands\-on experience in production\-level, cloud\-hosted data\-as\-a\-service application. In this role, you will primarily work on data warehousing\- involving data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL processes including hands on in Data Build Tool (DBT) or any such build tools. You will be responsible for querying using SQL,write functions and stored procedures, and more. On any given day, you might be architecting data ingestion and warehousing solutions, and delivering data to our customers or internal applications through queries and functions. You will follow best practices in code and design, secure coding practices, and review data architecture, modeling, and queries from development through to completion in a live production environment.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development , this role is part of a Scrum team for developing product (s) within the Data Platform team . The role will be involved with developing customer facing cloud hosted data as service products . This role necessitates meetings and require heavy collaboration within and across many teams . Our business model is hybrid, working from our B angalore campus.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement data ingestion and warehousing solutions.
* Develop and maintain data models, ETL, and reverse ETL processes.
* Write and optimize SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures.
* Ensure best practices in code and design, including secure coding practices.
* Review and improve data architecture, modeling, and queries.
* Deliver data solutions to customers and internal applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to meet project goals.


 Your Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2\-4 years of professional experience in a data\-related software engineering role.
* Experience in Snowflake, DBT models.
* Hands\-on experience with coding, analytical, and data querying knowledge.
* Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle and Agile software development.
* Solid design knowledge to create extensible, reusable data deliveries that meet architectural objectives and security assessments.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and quickly get up to speed.
* Ability to work autonomously and in teams.
* Excitement for new technologies and challenges of scale.
* Proficiency in:
* Data Build Tool (DBT) or any analogous tool
* Data warehousing, including data modeling, ETL, and reverse ETL
* SQL queries, functions, and stored procedures
* Various data delivery methodologies (files, streams, APIs)
* Understanding of data\-related application SDKs


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools like Terraform.
* Familiarity with AWS
* Knowledge of programming languages such as Python and PowerShell.


 As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. Therefore we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world−regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law.

title: Network Automation Solution Developer
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Network Automation Solution Developer, you will validate Service Portals and ensure their reliability for leading telecom operators. Working with agile, cross\-functional teams, you will develop and execute test strategies for orchestration, automation, and service assurance across IP/MPLS networks. You will leverage test automation tools, troubleshoot issues, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to continuous integration and delivery, helping deliver high\-quality network automation solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and implement comprehensive end\-to\-end test strategies for Service Portals, focusing on performance and reliability.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework for regression, functional, and system testing.
* Validate complex IP/MPLS network topologies, ensuring thorough testing of orchestration and automation functionalities.
* Troubleshoot issues, conduct root cause analysis, and collaborate with developers to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines by integrating automated testing within the release process.
* Review and assess product requirements and design documents to ensure they meet testability standards.
* Mentor junior QA engineers, providing guidance and participating in peer reviews to enhance team skills.
* Report on quality metrics, defect tracking, and performance validation to ensure high\-quality product releases.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**You have:**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Telecommunications, IP Networking, or related field
* 10 years of experience in software quality assurance, with at least 2 years in the telecom/networking domain.
* Proficiency in Robot Framework, Python/Java scripting, and test automation design patterns
* Strong understanding of IP and network virtualization concepts.


**It would be nice if you also had:**
* Familiarity with Nokia NSP architecture and service provisioning (e.g., L3VPN, TE tunnels)
* Experience with Linux\-based environments, network emulators (e.g., IXIA, Spirent), and protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark)
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and documentation skills.


**About Us**
**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**
 Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Nokia .
   

  

**Our recruitment process**
 We act inclusively and respect the uniqueness of people. Our employment decisions are made regardless of race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. We are committed to a culture of inclusion built upon our core value of respect.
   

  

 If you’re interested in this role but don’t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences enrich our teams, and you may be just the right candidate for this or another opportunity.
   

  

 The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .
   

  

**About The Team**
 Some of our benefits in India:
   

  

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements to support work–life balance
* Health and well\-being support – medical insurance for you and your family, health check\-ups, life and accident insurance, well\-being programs, and employee resource groups
* A minimum of 90 days of Maternity and Paternity Leave based on eligibility
* Personal Support Service 24/7 – a confidential support channel open to all Nokia employees and their families in challenging situations
* Career growth \& mobility – technical career paths, job rotations, international assignments, and relocation support
* Continuous learning – technical certifications, mentoring programs, coaching, and digital learning platforms
* Opportunities to innovate and contribute through Nokia’s research and development environment
* Recognition programs that celebrate outstanding contributions
* Workplace support – ergonomic working support and mobile device programs based on eligibility

title: Principal Consultant-Ecology
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 36,000 people, in over 70 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 Join our dynamic, internationally focused ecology team delivering high\-impact solutions for UK projects. As a Principal Consultant – Ecology, you will lead technical delivery, team growth, and innovation in ecological services, leveraging advanced digital tools and global best practices.
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Technical Leadership \& Reporting
+ Lead and author high\-quality ecological reports, including scoping and baseline sections of Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs), Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) reports, and related technical documents.
+ Oversee the quality assurance and technical accuracy of project deliverables, ensuring compliance with UK and European standards.

* Team Management \& Mentoring
+ Manage and mentor a team of 8\-10 ecology professionals, fostering a collaborative, high\-performance culture and supporting individual career development.
+ Take responsibility for securing work, including identifying new opportunities, building relationship and contributing to business growth.
+ Contribute to team growth, succession planning, and skills development in line with the latest industry trends.

* Field Expertise \& Innovation
+ Design, supervise, and review ecological and species surveys, and habitat assessments relevant to UK and European contexts.
+ Apply advanced identification skills for a range of taxa/species associated with key habitats, leveraging international experience and transferable knowledge (e.g., bat species across geographies).

* Legislation \& Policy Application
+ Demonstrate expert knowledge and application of UK and European environmental legislation, policy, and best practice guidance.


* Digital \& Analytical Excellence
+ Utilise advanced digital tools (e.g., GIS, R, Bat Explorer, AI\-powered ecology platforms) for field data collection, analysis, and reporting.
+ Champion digital transformation and innovation within the ecology team.
+ Identify and support build areas of standardisation and automation
+ Able to manage internal and external Quality Audit.

* Safety \& Biosecurity
+ Take full responsibility for adherence to biosecurity and health and safety protocols across all project phases.

* Stakeholder Engagement
+ Act as a key point of contact for clients, regulators, and partners, demonstrating outstanding communication and influencing skills.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Education: Master’s degree (minimum) in Zoology, Ecology, Conservation Biology, or a related environmental discipline. Candidates with a PhD and strong industry experience will be highly preferred.
* Professional Membership: Membership of a relevant professional body (e.g., CIEEM, IES) – or international equivalent – is desirable.
* Experience:
+ 15–20 years of relevant professional experience in ecological consultancy, conservation, or related sectors.
+ Proven track record of delivering UK\-based ecology projects from India or similar international contexts.
+ Demonstrated experience in managing and developing high\-performing teams.

* Technical Skills:
+ Advanced knowledge and operational proficiency in ArcGIS, bat analysis software, and digital data management tools.
+ Proven report writing and review capabilities for large consultancy and donor agencies.
+ Hands\-on experience with AI applications in ecology is a strong advantage.

* Other Skills:
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex information to technical and non\-technical audiences.
+ Proficiency in foreign languages (especially relevant to UK/European contexts) is an added advantage.

* Desirable Attributes
+ Experience with global or cross\-continental ecological projects.
+ Passion for innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability.

title: Production Development Engineer II
description:
**Requistion ID** 
 : \[\[id]]
   

  

 Wellspect Healthcare is a leading global provider of innovative medical devices that help people suffering from urinary retention or chronic constipation. More than 1,000 employees around the world are dedicated to making a difference to people who need our products and services. Wellspect is one of the worlds’ leading manufacturers of intermittent urinary catheters, with LoFric® as the most known brand. As a help to those with chronic or severe constipation Wellspect has developed what likely is the world’s most advanced irrigation system, Navina™, combining a high degree of user convenience, clinical effectiveness and connectivity into one smart system. Wellspect strives to become climate neutral and leave the smallest possible environmental footprint.
   

  

 The company, with headquarters in Mölndal, Sweden, is present in more than 30 countries, and part of Dentsply Sirona, the worlds´ largest manufacturer of professional dental technologies. The company’s shares are listed in the United States on NASDAQ under the symbol XRAY. Visit www.wellspect.com and www.dentsplysirona.com for more information.
   

  

**Production Development Engineer \- Mechanical Design Engineer**
 Join our Production Development team and continue shaping medical device production of tomorrow.
   

  

 Wellspect is continuing to step up the pace in product and production development. We are now offering a position as a Production Development Engineer with focus on Mechanical Design.
   

  

 At Wellspect, we are proud to have an in\-house, highly automated medical device production with interconnected chemical processes, multiple transport systems and packaging machines. We have strict requirements on material traceability and in\-line quality control; an area where we apply Big Data principles and develop machine learning. As a Production Development Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of new and improved production processes as well as ensuring compliance with existing production equipment, with a strong focus on mechanical design.
   

  

**Your Key Accountabilities Are**
* Lead or participate in equipment investment projects all the way from concept, via risk\- and requirements handling, testing and validation to commissioning and handover.
* Participate in cross\-functional project teams, where you will collaborate with both external equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders/departments to find efficient production solutions with Design for Manufacturing as a guiding principle.
* Manage and participate hands\-on in installation, start\-up/commissioning, testing/verification activities in our cleanroom production in Mölndal.
* Lead or participate in improvement projects both related to ongoing production but also to the ways of working within production development.
* Develop documentation in compliance with Wellspect’s quality management system built on regulatory requirements from European medical device and FDA quality systems regulations.
* Establish and maintain working relationships with suppliers including evaluations and supplier visits.
* Perform mechanical design and create 2D/3D drawings and participate during building of custom designed equipment.


**Who You Are**
 You are a positive and driven team player with strong communication skills. You enjoy collaborating and are motivated by working together with highly skilled and committed colleagues. You are open to challenges and appreciate a role where your contribution makes a real difference every day.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* An academic background, preferably in mechanical engineering or equivalent with experience from production development
* Experience of mechanical design and building custom design equipment
* Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, materials science, and manufacturing processes
* CAD Software Skills: Proficiency in CAD software, AutoCAD Inventor
* Knowledge of automated manufacturing process development, preferably from food/life science or other regulated industry
* Some project management experience
* Experience working with technical specifications and external equipment suppliers
* Knowledge of Lean production and Design for Manufacturing principles
* Experience from qualification/testing/process validation, preferably within life science or other regulated industry
* An interest in and understanding of automation technology including Industry 4\.0 principles
* Some experience with data collection and predictive analysis in a production environment
* Documentation and communication skills, in English as well as in Swedish

description:

 💰 \*\*

 per month

 We are looking for an organised and responsible
 
 ﻿
 
 \*\*Dispatch Incharge\*\* to independently handle our \*\*offline orders, bulk shipments, Amazon FBA shipments, marketplace dispatches and stock maintenance\*\*. The candidate should have strong warehouse coordination skills, accuracy in stock handling and the ability to ensure that every shipment leaves \*\*on time, in the correct quantity and with proper documentation\*\*. \#\#\# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \*\*
 





 1\. Daily Dispatch Management\*\*
 





 • Plan and supervise day\-to\-day dispatch activities
 





 • Ensure orders are picked, checked, packed and dispatched on time
 





 • Handle offline, wholesale, bulk and institutional orders
 





 • Coordinate courier, transport and logistics pickups
 





 • Verify quantity, SKU, size, colour and packing before dispatch
 





 • Ensure correct invoices, labels and shipment documents are attached

 • Ensure correct product labelling, carton labelling and packing

 • Prepare cartons according to marketplace requirements
 





 • Maintain carton\-wise and SKU\-wise shipment records
 





 • Coordinate transport / pickup for bulk FBA consignments
 





 • Track shipments until warehouse delivery
 





 • Identify shortages, discrepancies or rejected quantities and follow up for resolution
 





 \*\*3\. Marketplace Shipments\*\*
 





 Coordinate dispatch requirements for marketplaces including:
 





 • Amazon
 





 • Flipkart
 





 • Myntra
 





 • Meesho
 





 • JioMart
 





 • Shopify / D2C orders
 





 • Other e\-commerce channels as required Ensure marketplace orders are processed within required timelines and avoid delays or dispatch errors.
 





 \*\*4\. Offline \& Bulk Orders\*\*
 





 • Handle distributor, retailer, wholesale and other offline shipments
 





 • Prepare order\-wise picking and packing requirements
 





 • Coordinate large\-volume dispatches
 





 • Verify final quantities against invoices / orders
 





 • Coordinate transport arrangements for bulk consignments
 





 • Maintain proof of dispatch and delivery documentation
 





 \*\*5\. Stock Maintenance\*\*
 





 • Maintain accurate physical stock of finished goods
 





 • Ensure inward and outward stock movements are recorded correctly
 





 • Maintain SKU / style / colour / size\-wise stock
 





 • Conduct regular physical stock verification
 





 • Identify stock mismatches and investigate differences
 





 • Monitor damaged, returned, rejected and non\-saleable stock separately
 





 • Coordinate stock transfers between production, warehouse and dispatch
 





 • Ensure stock is stored systematically for easy identification and picking
 





 \*\*6\. Warehouse Organisation\*\*
 





 • Ensure products are stored in clearly identified locations
 





 • Maintain proper racks, bins and SKU identification
 





 • Improve picking and packing efficiency
 





 • Ensure stock is not mixed between styles, sizes or colours
 





 • Maintain cleanliness and organisation in the dispatch and stock areas
 





 • Monitor packing\-material availability
 





 • Inform management in advance when cartons, covers, labels or other materials are running low
 





 \*\*7\. Returns \& Stock Reconciliation\*\*
 





 • Receive returned shipments and verify quantities
 





 • Coordinate checking of returned products
 





 • Segregate saleable, damaged and defective returns
 





 • Ensure returned stock is correctly updated in inventory
 





 • Maintain proper records of marketplace and customer returns
 





 • Report discrepancies to the operations team / management
 





 \*\*8\. Team Handling\*\*
 





 • Allocate work to picking, packing and dispatch staff
 





 • Monitor daily productivity and pending orders
 





 • Ensure staff follow correct packing and stock\-handling processes
 





 • Train new warehouse / dispatch employees
 





 • Maintain discipline and accountability within the dispatch team
 





 • Coordinate closely with production, e\-commerce, accounts and operations teams
 





 \#\#\# REPORTING \& CONTROL The Dispatch Incharge should regularly track:
 





 • Orders pending for dispatch
 





 • Orders dispatched
 





 • FBA shipments pending / completed
 





 • Bulk shipments
 





 • Courier / transporter handovers
 





 • Physical stock
 





 • Stock discrepancies
 





 • Returns received
 





 • Damaged / rejected stock
 





 • Packing\-material availability Any mismatch or delay should be identified and reported quickly rather than discovered later during reconciliation.
 





 \#\#\# CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
 





 • \*\*2–7 years of experience\*\* in dispatch, warehouse, inventory or logistics operations
 





 • Experience in garments, textiles, e\-commerce or consumer products preferred
 





 • Experience handling \*\*bulk shipments and inventory\*\*

 • Good understanding of SKU\-wise stock maintenance

 \#\#\# IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who can independently take ownership of:
 





 \*\*Stock → Order → Picking → Checking → Packing → Documentation → Dispatch → Tracking → Reconciliation
 





 \*\* The person should understand that dispatch is not simply moving cartons out of the warehouse. The responsibility is to ensure:

 \#\#\# COMPENSATION 💰 \*\*₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
