 Job Name PA (Business Unit) : Personal Banker Classic Job Title : Personal Banker Business Unit (PA) : RBB Team : ) Retail Branch Banking Reports to (job) : Branch Head 
 Job Fn : Sales Role Type: Individual Contributor 
 Job Purpose Is responsible for Classic portfolio management by acquisition of new Classic customers and enhancement of the relationship by cross-selling products and services as per the profile & need of the customers. Acquiring family accounts and deepening the size of the relationship and retention of the customers by providing the best possible services and being the dedicated point of contact for these customers. So that We become the primary banker for these Classic relationships and maximize the share of wallet of these customers. Job Responsibilities(JR) 
 Actionable Sales 
 Maintain Daily Sales Report CH 106 and CH 104 Calling Structured bundled offering of Products and Services to the customer within the defined time line Ensure quality new acquisition on SA and CA for Resident/Non Resident Walk Ins Portfolio Referrals Friends Associates Family members Attrition control Includes persuading the customer to continue and if required renew FDs Deepen by cross selling sticky products like Demat, Bill Pay, Advisory. Ensure quality of relationship while flagging. Should be capable of maintaining eligibility Regular customer contact to establish needs of the customer and opportunities to cross-sell Monitor large amount movements and account closure from the deposit accounts and ensure that customer does not attrite Ensure that the marketing analytics list on possible attrite, is called and retained Penetration of Saving Accounts on non liability customers Propagate the benefits of not being on DNC registration list in case a non-portfolio customer opts for it Utilizing the sales resources (BDR/COEX) for optimal sales support Penetration of FD to unique customers Using Data-mine for cross-selling Sales of various Credit Cards Activation Pitch for enhancement of limits Promote active usage of credit cards Ensure that the customer avails of add-on card for his family members Sales of Third Party Products to the customers MF/Insurance/RBI Bonds Ensure that requisite certifications are done (NISM V-A) Sales of Asset Products Disseminating product information Activation: To ensure that all accounts savings and current account (non ABM branches) opened in the month are activated as per product definition at the end of the next month. All such accounts to maintain more than the required AMB Activation of LTD a/cs: To ensure that all LTD accounts are activated and remain in the same state month on month. Maintain the list of active and inactive customers for both CA and SB and engage with the customers for balance build up and cross sell. Calling of customers who have not transacted and know the reasons. Escalate to BM / Product on any change in market situation / threat from competition due to which customers have stopped operations. Corporate Salary: Calling on customers who transfer their salary a/cs to other banks immediately on credit To ensure such customers are engaged and brought back to bank fold To cross sell loan products with other banks for which such transfer may take place To cross sell investments to such customers by which they will tend to maintain balances Calling on Large Value Attrition: Customers who have attrited over a certain value (as defined by product) for both savings and current accounts to be called and reasons ascertained To impress upon customers to make us the primary bankers and ensure that all funds are retained. Enhancing customer wallet size Ensuring that customers make us their primary bank Knowing about where all the customer is currently banking and moving him to our Bank Ensuring that customer scope is done and products targeted accordingly Sales to family members and associates (all network) Attrition control of customers Includes persuading the customer to continue and if required renew FDs Monitor large amount movements / account closure from the deposit accounts and ensure that customer does not attrite Ensure that the marketing analytics list on possible attrite, is called and retained Managing Classic Portfolio 
 Manage the benchmark no. of customers in the portfolio Extend Classic benefits to customers basis identification in eligibility lists/ LTR Ensure that individual customers are grouped and C ustomer T o G roup (CTG) Ratio is maintained on the portfolio By grouping them with their family members who already hold accounts with us By grouping them with their family members post selling liability products to the family members, if they do not have banking relationship with us Ensure that optimal levels of I ncome generating P roduct G roup H olding (IPH) is reached Ensure that within each customer group a minimum number of stipulated Income Generating products are sold Ensure that the Customer Group profitability is achieved Manage Band 1 and 2 customers and ensure that they are moved to Band 3 and above Enhance Values within each of the customer groups Online updation of CRMNext at every stage of customer contact on the portfolio Proactively raising the eligible customers to the classic portfolio within the prescribed product product programme Ensure that all classic customers within the portfolio are contacted Usage of APT and data in CRM for effective call planning and review with BH / PBA(Pre call planning and post call review ) Detailed updation of interaction to be captured in CRM , Tasks/ leads to be created , profiler to be updated on same day of interaction. Achievement of income plans and other benchmarks within portfolio 
 Ensure that income plans for the month and year are duly met across products Achieving of portfolio level benchmarks of and IPH Income product to be sold to each group of the portfolio in the year Ensure that the benchmark sales per month is met Usage of netbanking / Mobile banking , Billpay , RDFD penetration benchmark to be met CEP to be met as per cycle All customers to have valid mobile and email address . Customer services 
 Ensure quality customer service is delivered Recording complaints as per the specified process Resolving all complaints received (self, branch, other units) within the stipulated TATs Ensure appropriate customer communication on closures & copy of that to be filed. Preventive complaint management Asking for feedback from customers, who may not be complaining Promoting all direct banking channels and ensuring that the customer is utilizing the same Check back on recent customers registered to DBC channel and give any specific help required Responsibility of opening the customer account within the TAT. Operations 
 Ensure certification of documentation required for opening and maintaining customer accounts Error free documentation for all account opening and all customer instructions (Stop payments, FD Closure, etc) Maintaining Tatkal kits as per laid down process As a locker custodian ensure that locker allotment and all other related operations is as per prescribed process Includes managing standing instructions Submission of daily e-schedule indicating the third party sales done Updation of CRM for the asset leads generated Updation of weed-out database on the portal Ensure KYC norms are adhered to at all points of time Ensure that 5-S norms are adhered to for individuals workstation Opening of accounts under smart account mode Educational Qualifications 
 Key Skills Graduation: Post-Graduation: Certifications: NISM V-A Certification IRDA Certification NCFM Certification (Optional) CAIIB (Optional) Internal Certification GI certification 
 Sales and Influencing Skills Banking Product & Process Knowledge NRI Product and Regulatory Knowledge Planning and Organizing Skills Communication Knowledge of Competition & Current trends in financial Industry . title: Power System Testing & Commissioning Engineer
company: Technical Institute Of Science And Engineering Consultant
description:
Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and technically skilled Testing and Commissioning (T&C) Engineer specializing in electrical power systems, substations, switchgear, and protection schemes. The successful candidate will be responsible for leading site testing activities, conducting pre-commissioning and commissioning checks on primary and secondary power equipment, ensuring adherence to safety codes, and handover of assets to clients in compliance with international standards (IEC, IEEE) and utility guidelines. Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies Site Execution & Planning: Plan, schedule, and execute comprehensive testing and commissioning activities for high-voltage (HV), medium-voltage (MV), and low-voltage (LV) electrical installations. Primary Equipment Testing: Perform routine and advanced factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) for primary equipment including Power Transformers, GIS/AIS Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, Current/Voltage Transformers (CT/VT), and Isolators. Protection & Control Testing: Conduct secondary injection testing, differential/overcurrent protection relay configuration and testing (ABB, Siemens, GE, SEL), metering verification, and interlock checks. Advanced Diagnostics: Execute specialized electrical measurements including Insulation Resistance (Megger), Polarization Index (PI), Winding Resistance, Tan Delta, Partial Discharge, Contact Resistance, and Earthing/Grounding resistance measurements. Wiring & SCADA Verification: Verify control and schematic wiring, perform loop checks, functional checks of SCADA/RTU integration, DC battery charger and UPS testing. Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot and diagnose complex electrical system faults, wiring discrepancies, or hardware failures during commissioning phases. Documentation & Handover: Prepare clear, precise T&C procedures, Method Statements, risk assessments (HSE), inspection checklists, and comprehensive final testing reports for client and utility approvals. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelors Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) or equivalent technical degree. Experience: 3 to 6 years of proven professional experience in testing and commissioning of electrical substations, power plants, or heavy industrial networks. Test Equipment Proficiency: Hands-on experience with advanced testing instruments (e.g., Omicron CPC100, CMC 356, Megger, Doble test sets). Standards & Compliance: In-depth knowledge of international standards (IEC, IEEE, BS, NETA) and local utility regulations. Technical Know-How: Strong understanding of electrical protection schemes, single-line diagrams (SLDs), schematic drawings, and wiring diagrams. Soft Skills & Safety: Outstanding communication skills, ability to lead on-site sub-contractors, and strict commitment to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. Preferred Qualifications Valid international or local utility approvals / certifications (e.g., DEWA, SEC, Kahramaa, or equivalent). Certification in relay configuration and advanced power testing (e.g., Omicron or Doble certified engineer). First Aid and high-voltage safety certifications.

title: Head Beauty
description:
KEY TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for monitoring the Administrative , Operational and Technical aspects & smooth functioning of the centre as a whole with emphasis on the Slimming and Beauty Sections in the Centres in order to ensure the optimum capacity utilization and quality service delivery to provide client delight: Documentation : Regular checking and corrective measures for filling of the Client Programme Records and other requisite documents & informing the Corporate Office. Ensure correct and timely software entries, checking them for necessary corrections. Monitoring Client Progress : Regular monitoring of progress of all clients. Organize periodic meetings with respective departments to resolve general and specific concerns. To interact with all clients (especially those losing slowly/not getting expected results ) personally and coordinate with R & D for further technical inputs, as and when required. Zero Sessions : Stringent Monitoring to ensure zero sessions are conducted as per SOP and within the stipulated timelines. Maintain liaison between the Centre and the Corporate Office. Knowledge transfer and technical inputs from R&D or Corporate Office to the respective Centre staff. To regularly update oneself on all Obesity / Beauty related research in ones region and share the relevant information pertaining to the same with R & D Dept. Communication, implementation and compliance of all Corporate policies in the Centre. Coordinate with Zonal head and Corporate Office in case of delays in the availability of stock - linen, documents, appliances and their accessories, and to ensure all equipment is in working condition at all times. To take Corporate guidance for booking of complicated Medical Cases. To take corrective measures, with advice from Corporate Office if required, in case of wrong bookings and medical contraindications. Executions & Compliance to SOP: To ensure that Centers achieve qualitative and quantitative executions as specified by the Corporate & according to the service delivery parameters given by R&D. To co-ordinate with R&D for any guidance regarding the same. Periodic technical audits and technical reviews of staff to check for compliance with SOP. Take corrective actions at Centre level and inform Corporate Office in case of deviations and refresher training required by the staff. Trainings : To identify the Training needs of the staff and inform the R & D of the following : - Training Needs -Fresher / Refresher / Advanced / Skill Gap Analysis / Other parameters requiring improvement on individual basis - To ensure stringent compliance of the Training Nomination SOP w.r.t Training Nomination Letter / Mandatory signing of Training Agreements by complete staff / Action on Non compliance - To ensure that the post Training Implementation feedback form is filled up for respective profiles as and when required and sent back to R & D - To ensure that the identified Centre staff ( Profilewise ) takes keen interest in the improvement of average performers and feedback of the same sent to the R & D Review the appointment planner: For optimum utilisation of infrastructure, staff and appliances. - To review and ensure that the Daily Monitoring Format is correctly and completely filled up and sent to the Corporate within the stipulated time line. Follow - up of irregular clients : Regular monitoring of client follow-up data wherever required and self follow-up for special clients including VIPs and Doctors. Unsuccessful but regular clients : Implementation of the specific technical inputs, including counseling of such clients and co-ordinate with Corporate Office for further technical inputs as and when required. To try and keep the percentage of USR clients within the minimum limit as specified by the Corporate. Validity Expiry : Monitoring of validities for calculations and informing the Corporate Office for any deviation and personal counseling of those clients who were regular but still could not complete the package. To try and expedite that the programme of maximum clients are completed within validity. Transfer/Conversion of Clients’ Progamme : Ensure that transfers/ conversions of the clients’ programme, if any, happen with the consent & coordination of client and the respective CH/AH. In case of inter centre transfers, to ensure transfer of client papers and credit note is done within 48 hours / before client approaches the concerned centre. Client complaints : Resolve escalated client issues and proactively initiate and reduce possible causes of complaints by customers. To ensure any client complaints is resolved within the next 7 days in case corporate intervention is required, else to resolve within the next 48 hours at the centre level itself. To ensure complete and fair compliance of the Customer Complaint SOP Staff : Recruitment and Induction: To ensure that the recruitments are done as per the specified SOP and to conduct the Induction of the new recruits as per designation wise Induction Schedules and to conduct induction sessions as specified for different profiles (Dietician / Slimming Head / Physiotherapist / Doctor / Beauty Head / Beauty Incharge / Hair Stylist / Pedicurist / Dermatologist) Induction : To assist in the recruitment of new Centre staff , conduct preliminary technical interviews of candidates in case of vacancy and forward for approval to Corporate Office. Orientation of Staff : To impart on-the-job training at Centre level, to new staff and send their periodic assessment to Corporate Office as specified in the SOP. Vacancies / TNA : Update the Corporate Office/Zonal Head periodically on the status for vacancies and training needs of the staff. Sales : Work with Sales team members & Slimming / Beauty In-charges to ensure meeting of in-house sales targets that may be set from time to time. To give realistic sales targets to individual staff members and monitor the same on a daily basis aiming towards the achievement of centre’s sales target. Events : To coordinate with the Corporate in giving technical support to the Centre for organizing the Events and sending feedback of the same to the Corporate. Two main events to be planned out and conducted every quarter, in co-ordination with the Corporate. Software entries: To ensure timely entries of data in the software and monitor the same. To send required data to IT department within the time line specified by the Corporate. On the basis of feedback given by the Corporate, actions to be immediately implemented and revertal on same given to the Corporate. Staff Attrition: To ensure that the staff attrition does not overshoot a maximum limit as specified by the Corporate. To ensure that all relevant contracts are in place for all staff members. To ensure optimum staff strength at the Centre at all times keeping in mind the influx and lean hours KEY ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES Sop’s: To ensure adherence & compliance to standard operating procedures at all times and to also ensure that standards are driven by the Center Manager(s) while providing ownership value. To oversee achievement of budgeted sales target every month & offer timely advice to team to review strategies to close sales & generate bookings more effectively and scientifically. Events : To review in consultation with Zonal head & Corporate approval – events / promotions planned, local ads to be released and unique packages formulated to match variety of budgets, in order to create & drive awareness about VLCC as a slimming, beauty & fitness ( Wellness ) brand. To ensure that the data on Centre level Marketing initiative / feedback is collated and analyzed and the same sent to the Head Marketing, Corporate and Regional VP Operations To promote WOL, family card or any other promotional programs / schemes that the corporate might launch from time to time . To monitor SMS data / Call Centre escalated queries / Alive Chat mails or any other marketing activities promoted by the marketing department at the corporate. To oversee monthly budget of the centre & team operations to bring down non-essential overhead costs without impacting quality of service. To monitor the effectiveness of yield/capacities in the centers and systems to ensure revenues are maximized and provide feedback to senior management To oversee duty roster & identify staff capable of multitasking and sending them for respective trainings for upgradation. Monthly/Dailly staff meetings : To help settle personnel grievances through a rational & open meeting or use personal discretion to intervene directly. To ensure that they are held on a monthly basis and to send the reports to the Corporate within the defined time line. To provide ongoing information and status reports to Regional Operations Head / Senior management team in the corporate on monthly basis on financial and operational performance of center(s). To oversee management & maintenance of all client records, attendance record, MIS reports, security arrangements, inventory control, compliance to all statutory obligations such as PF, ESIC, Bonus etc.. Checklists : To inspect the center by taking rounds and ensure that the upkeep is as per standard norms and the hygiene and sanitation conditions are par excellence. In addition ensure that machines are in working order. To fill the checklists on a monthly basis and forward the same to the Corporate within the stipulated time line. To explain the details of incentive plan / salary break up and regularly coordinate with HR on timely distribution of salaries and incentives to the center staff. To put forth recommendations to corporate office for centre renovation, relocation/ termination of manpower, and closure of certain sections of centre & discontinuing use of certain machines To conduct regular checks at the center to ensure consumption of products as per SOP and services executed at the centers and FIFO policy is being adhered to for product consumption / retail chain. To constantly upgrade oneself so as to achieve the progression level as per the multitasking / up gradation planner Additional Responsibilities: 1. title: Hr Executive And Recruiter
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 HR Executive Talent Acquisition & HR Operations 
 Department: Human Resources
 Designation: HR Executive
 Location: Vasant Vihar 
 Reporting To: HR Manager 
 Experience: 13 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 1. Job Summary 
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive to manage end-to-end recruitment, talent acquisition, employee onboarding, pre-boarding, HR documentation, and exit formalities.
The candidate will be responsible for sourcing and screening suitable candidates, coordinating interviews, maintaining recruitment records in KEKA , ensuring smooth joining formalities, and supporting day-to-day HR operations.
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment 
 Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from candidate sourcing to joining.
 Understand manpower requirements and coordinate with HR manager for open positions.
 Search and source candidates through Naukri/Resdex, job portals, LinkedIn, employee references, databases, and other recruitment channels .
 Screen resumes based on job requirements, experience, qualifications, location, and role suitability.
 Conduct initial HR screening calls with shortlisted candidates.
 Explain the job profile, responsibilities, location, working hours, salary structure, and other relevant requirements to candidates.
 Maintain an active candidate pipeline for current and upcoming vacancies.
 Follow up with candidates regularly throughout the recruitment process.
 Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies.
 B. Interview Coordination 
 Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and HR Manager and CEO.
 Align interview slots based on candidate and interviewer availability.
 Share interview details and candidate profiles with HR Manager.
 Maintain proper records of scheduled, completed, shortlisted, rejected, and pending interviews.
 Take regular feedback from interviewers and update candidates accordingly.
 Ensure minimum delays between different stages of the recruitment process.
 Follow up with candidates who miss or postpone interviews and reschedule wherever required.
 C. Candidate Calling & Follow-Ups 
 Make regular recruitment calls to prospective candidates.
 Follow up with shortlisted candidates regarding interview schedules, documentation, salary discussions, and joining dates.
 Maintain professional communication with candidates throughout the hiring process.
 Track candidates who are under offer, serving notice period, or awaiting joining.
 Reduce candidate drop-offs through timely communication and engagement.
 D. Pre-Boarding 
 Coordinate with selected candidates before their date of joining.
 Collect and verify required pre-joining documents.
 Share joining instructions, reporting details, location, timings, and other relevant information.
 Maintain regular communication with candidates during the notice period.
 Confirm joining status one day prior to the joining date.
 Coordinate with the concerned department/clinic to ensure readiness for the new employee.
 E. Onboarding & Joining Formalities 
 Coordinate complete employee onboarding and joining formalities.
 Ensure all required documents and employee information are collected.
 Create/update employee records in KEKA .
 Ensure timely completion of joining documentation and HR formalities.
 Coordinate with relevant departments for ID cards, system access, email IDs, uniforms, assets, and other requirements wherever applicable.
 Ensure new employees are properly introduced to the organization and reporting structure.
 Coordinate with reporting managers regarding the employee's joining and induction.
 F. KEKA HRMS Management 
 Maintain accurate employee and recruitment-related information in KEKA SOFTWARE .
 Update candidate/employee status at every relevant stage.
 Complete joining and onboarding activities in KEKA.
 Initiate and track required HR processes and notifications through KEKA.
 Maintain employee records, documentation, attendance-related information, and separation records as assigned.
 Ensure timely and accurate HRMS data updates.
 G. Exit & Separation Formalities 
 Coordinate employee resignation and separation processes.
 Ensure employees complete required exit formalities and documentation.
 Coordinate with reporting managers and concerned departments for clearance and handover.
 Initiate and update separation formalities in KEKA.
 Coordinate asset handover, department clearance, and other exit requirements.
 Maintain proper records of resigned, relieved, and separated employees.
 Coordinate with HR/Finance/concerned departments regarding Full & Final (F&F) formalities as per company policy.
 Conduct or coordinate exit interviews and maintain relevant records.
 
 4. Required Skills & Competencies 
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
 Good candidate sourcing and screening skills.
 Strong calling and follow-up abilities.
 Good knowledge of recruitment processes.
 Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
 Strong coordination and time-management skills.
 Good working knowledge of KEKA or other HRMS platforms .
 Working knowledge of Naukri/Resdex, LinkedIn, and other recruitment platforms.
 Good MS Excel/Google Sheets skills.
 Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
 Ability to work under deadlines and achieve recruitment targets.
 Proactive approach with strong ownership and follow-through.
 Professional and positive attitude.

 5. Qualification & Experience 
 Education: Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
 Experience: 03 years of experience in HR recruitment/talent acquisition or HR operations.
Candidates with experience in healthcare, aesthetics, wellness, clinics, hospitality, retail, sales, or other high-volume recruitment environments will be preferred

Support implementation of applicable labour and employment-related requirements. Coordinate with external consultants or management for statutory HR compliance, where required. 12. Coordination with Management

Highlight employee-related risks, concerns, and trends. Support management in implementing HR initiatives and organizational changes. Candidate Profile

IndustryAcademiaGovernment Projects Build consortiums involving: Industry + Start-up/MSME + University/R&D Institution + Government/End User for eligible R&D and innovation programmes. The candidate shall identify complementary capabilities and prepare consortium proposals with clearly defined: Technical responsibilities Financial responsibilities Intellectual-property ownership Technology-transfer arrangements Milestones Deliverables Commercialisation rights Compliance obligations 8. Monitoring and Compliance Maintain a comprehensive database of: Funding schemes Funding calls Application deadlines Eligibility criteria Submitted proposals Sanctioned projects Funding amount Disbursement milestones Utilisation certificates Project milestones Government correspondence Audit requirements Reporting requirements Ensure that no funding claim, eligibility statement or proposal is submitted without verification against the latest applicable Government notification/guidelines.

description:

The role is responsible for understanding end-to-end business processes, application architecture, system integrations, and customer journeys to effectively manage service reliability and drive continuous improvement. Working with support partners, engineering teams, and business stakeholders, the role uses observability, operational data, and technical analysis to identify issues, improve application resilience, increase automation, and enhance customer and business outcomes. The role also supports the adoption of AIOps and self-healing capabilities to improve operational efficiency and service quality.

Monitor service health, performance, and availability using observability platforms and operational metrics, proactively identifying risks and improvement opportunities. Investigate complex production issues through analysis of application logs, database queries, transaction flows, and monitoring data to support rapid resolution and root cause identification. Provide technical oversight on investigations, validating root causes, challenging assumptions, and ensuring high-quality incident resolution. Driving incident, problem, and change management activities, leveraging root cause analysis, preventive actions, and continuous service improvement to enhance reliability and prevent recurring issues. Partner with engineering, business, and supplier teams to deliver application, operational, and customer experience improvements aligned to business objectives. Develop and maintain service dashboards, operational reporting, and performance insights to support governance, decision-making, and continuous improvement. Identify and implement opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-driven operational capabilities to improve efficiency, resilience, and customer outcomes

Strong understanding of application architecture, system integrations, data flows and customer-facing business processes. Ability to analyse application, middleware and infrastructure logs to identify issues and support root cause investigations. Knowledge of SQL/Oracle databases with experience troubleshooting production application issues. Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as Dynatrace, including dashboard creation, alert analysis and trend identification. Understanding of Java-based applications, APIs, integration services and AWS-hosted platforms. Experience working with incident, problem, change and release management processes. Ability to identify automation, resilience and customer experience improvement opportunities through operational insights. In this role, you will lead end-to-end execution of complex electrical engineering projectsranging from high-voltage substations and power distribution networks to industrial plants and renewable energy integration. You will oversee project scope, financial budgets, schedules, resource allocation, technical quality, safety compliance, and client relations, ensuring successful project delivery from inception through engineering, procurement, construction (EPC), testing, and final handover. Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies Project Lifecycle Management: Direct and manage full project lifecycles for electrical engineering projects, ensuring delivery on-time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Planning & Scheduling: Develop comprehensive project management plans, work breakdown structures (WBS), master schedules (Primavera P6/MS Project), and milestone tracking metrics. Financial & Budget Control: Monitor project financial performance, including budgeting, cost forecasting, cash flow tracking, invoice approvals, variation order management, and profit-margin optimization. Team Leadership & Coordination: Lead multi-disciplinary engineering teams (Design, Procurement, Site Execution, Testing & Commissioning) and coordinate effectively with subcontractors and vendors. Technical & Regulatory Compliance: Ensure strict compliance with technical specifications, international design codes (IEC, IEEE, NEC), and local utility regulations across all project phases. Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, consultants, and stakeholders, managing expectations, reporting progress, and resolving contractual or technical disputes. HSE & Quality Assurance: Implement robust Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) protocols and rigorous Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) measures across all work sites. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 8 to 12 years of professional experience in electrical engineering, with at least 4 to 5 years in a project management or leadership capacity handling power systems/substations. Certifications: Professional certification such as Project Management Professional (PMP) or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) is highly preferred. Software Proficiency: Proven expertise in project scheduling tools (Primavera P6, MS Project) and financial/ERP management systems. Technical Background: Comprehensive technical knowledge of electrical primary/secondary equipment, protection systems, power studies, and site testing procedures. Soft Skills: Exceptional negotiation, leadership, conflict resolution, and written/verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Professional Engineer (PE) license or Chartered Engineer (CEng) status. Demonstrated track record of delivering major utility or industrial EPC electrical projects in the region. Experience handling contractual frameworks (FIDIC contracts).

title: Mep Engineer
description:
Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) services for large-scale IT park/commercial building projects, ensuring that all MEP works are executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project standards and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. MEP Coordination Coordinate HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV services with civil, structural, architectural and interior works. Review MEP layouts, GFC/shop drawings, specifications and BOQs before execution. Identify and resolve service clashes and interface issues to minimize rework. Coordinate service routing, ceiling spaces, shafts, plant rooms and equipment areas. Conduct regular coordination meetings with contractors, subcontractors, consultants and project teams. 2. Site Execution & Supervision Monitor day-to-day MEP installation activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings and specifications. Supervise HVAC, ducting, piping, electrical containment, cabling, plumbing, drainage, firefighting and related MEP works. Check workmanship, installation quality, levels, alignment, supports and accessibility for maintenance. Identify site constraints and provide practical engineering solutions. 3. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review and coordinate GFC, shop drawings, builders-work drawings and as-built drawings. Check technical submittals, material approvals, method statements and installation procedures. Raise and follow up RFIs/TQs for design clarifications. Coordinate revisions arising from site conditions and client/consultant comments. Ensure the latest approved drawings are available at site. 4. HVAC Coordination Coordinate AHU, FCU, VRF/VRV, ventilation and exhaust systems. Coordinate ductwork, chilled-water/refrigerant piping, insulation, supports and equipment installation. Verify equipment locations, service clearances and maintenance access. Coordinate HVAC works with electrical, fire-fighting, plumbing, ceiling and architectural requirements. 5. Electrical & ELV Coordination Coordinate cable trays, trunking, conduits, busducts and electrical equipment. Coordinate electrical power, lighting, DBs, panels, UPS and related systems. Interface with ELV systems such as fire alarm, CCTV, access control, BMS, data/ICT and other building systems as applicable. Ensure proper coordination between electrical services and other MEP systems. 6. Plumbing & Fire Protection Coordination Coordinate domestic water supply, drainage, sanitary, rainwater and related plumbing services. Coordinate fire-fighting piping, pumps, hydrants, sprinklers and associated services. Ensure proper routing, slopes, supports, access and maintenance clearances. 7. Quality Control & Inspection Conduct regular inspections of MEP installations. Verify materials against approved specifications and material submittals. Prepare/coordinate inspection requests and obtain consultant/client approvals. Identify defects and ensure timely rectification. Maintain inspection records, checklists and snag lists. 8. Testing & Commissioning Coordinate testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV systems. Witness and document testing activities as required. Coordinate TAB activities for HVAC systems where applicable. Ensure all commissioning records and test certificates are properly maintained. Support final snagging, system demonstrations and project handover. 9. Progress & Contractor Management Monitor daily and weekly MEP progress against the project programme. Coordinate manpower, materials, equipment and work fronts with subcontractors. Follow up material deliveries and ensure materials are properly stored. Monitor subcontractor productivity and workmanship. Highlight delays, constraints and potential programme impacts to the Project Manager. 10. Safety Ensure MEP activities comply with project HSE requirements. Coordinate safe working practices, permits, work-at-height requirements and PPE compliance. Participate in toolbox meetings and site safety inspections. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe storage of MEP materials. 11. Documentation & Reporting Prepare daily/weekly MEP progress reports. Maintain drawing registers, RFI/TQ registers, inspection records and material approval status. Maintain snag lists and monitor closure. Coordinate preparation and submission of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, test reports and commissioning documents. Assist in monthly progress measurement and contractor billing verification where required. Required Skills & Experience Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or related Engineering discipline. Relevant experience in large-scale commercial/IT park projects preferred. Good knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV coordination. Ability to read and interpret MEP drawings and specifications. Knowledge of AutoCAD; Revit/Navisworks knowledge is an advantage. Good understanding of site execution, testing and commissioning. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to coordinate multiple subcontractors and disciplines simultaneously. Good knowledge of quality and safety requirements. Preferred Project Experience Experience in the following types of projects will be an advantage: IT Parks / Data Centres Commercial Buildings SEZ Projects High-rise Buildings Office Campuses Industrial Buildings Large-scale HVAC and MEP projects Key Performance Areas (KPIs) MEP work completed as per project schedule Reduction of service clashes and rework Quality of MEP installation Timely closure of inspections and RFIs Contractor/subcontractor coordination Testing & commissioning completion Snag-free handover Safety compliance Accuracy and timely submission of MEP documentation Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Paid time off Petrol allowan ce

Design and implement LAN zoning and segmentation strategies to isolate traffic, enhance security, and optimize performance. Ensure optimal performance of wired and wireless LAN systems across office and data center locations. Management of network devices with Cisco Catalyst Center Troubleshoot LAN-related issues and coordinate with desktop support teams for resolution. Wide Area Network (WAN): Support and maintain WAN connectivity between branch offices, data centers, and cloud environments. Configure and monitor routers, firewalls, and inter-site routing protocols. Collaborate with ISPs and vendors to manage bandwidth, SLAs, and troubleshoot external connectivity issues. Assist in implementing SD-WAN solutions and optimizing WAN traffic routing. Administer and troubleshoot Cisco network devices including routers and switches. Virtual Private Network (VPN): Configure and maintain secure VPN tunnels for remote access and site-to-site connectivity. Monitor VPN performance and availability, ensuring secure and reliable access for users and systems. Troubleshoot VPN-related issues and support end-users with connectivity problems. Ensure VPN configurations comply with organizational security policies. Wireless Network: Deploy and manage wireless access points and controllers across office and campus environments. Monitor wireless network performance, coverage, and interference. Implement wireless security protocols including WPA2/WPA3 and guest access controls. Conduct periodic site surveys and optimize wireless configurations for performance and reliability. Integrate wireless LAN with Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) for centralized authentication, policy enforcement, and device profiling. Ensure secure onboarding of users and devices through ISE-based access control and posture assessment. Proxy Operations: Configure and manage proxy servers to control and monitor internet access. Implement URL filtering, content control, and user authentication policies. Analyze proxy logs for usage patterns, security threats, and performance issues. Ensure proxy services align with organizational compliance and security standards. Firewall Operations: Administer firewall policies and rule sets to protect network boundaries. Monitor firewall logs and alerts suspicious activity and potential threats. Perform regular audits and updates to firewall configurations. Collaborate with security teams to implement intrusion prevention and detection systems. Cloud Network Management: Manage and monitor cloud-based networking components across platforms such as AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Configure virtual networks, subnets, gateways, and security groups in cloud environments. Integrate on-premises networks with cloud infrastructure using VPNs and hybrid connectivity solutions. Ensure cloud network security, scalability, and compliance with organizational standards. Collaborate with cloud architects and DevOps teams to support cloud-native applications and services. Configuration & Deployment Assist in deploying and configuring network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, proxy servers, and wireless controllers. Maintain accurate documentation of network topology, configurations, and changes. Security & Compliance Implement network security measures such as ACLs, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems. Support compliance with internal security policies and external regulatory requirements. Support & Collaboration Provide Tier 2/3 support for network-related incidents and service requests. Work closely with system administrators, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors. Participate in on-call rotations and incident response activities. title: Government R&D and Innovation Funding Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities The primary objective of this position is to build and manage a Government Funding Pipeline for the Drone Manufacturing Hub and its participating projects. The incumbent will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop proposals for: Research & Development Advanced drone technologies Indigenous drone components Prototyping and product development Testing and certification infrastructure Manufacturing infrastructure Technology commercialisation Defence and dual-use technologies Artificial intelligence and autonomous systems Robotics and swarm technologies Agriculture and precision applications Mapping, surveying and geospatial applications Communication, navigation and sensing technologies Battery, propulsion and power systems Electronics, avionics and flight-control systems Technology transfer and industry-academia collaboration Start-up and MSME innovation programmes Key Responsibilities 1. Government Funding Identification Continuously identify and track relevant Government of India funding schemes, calls for proposals, grants, soft loans, equity/innovation support, challenge programmes and other eligible financial instruments. The role will monitor programmes and institutions including, as applicable: Department of Science & Technology (DST) Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF) Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund Technology Development Board (TDB) Ministry of Defence / Department of Defence Production iDEX Innovations for Defence Excellence Technology Development Fund (TDF) Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), where relevant to biotechnology/agri-biotech drone applications Ministry of Civil Aviation Other Central Government Ministries and Departments State Government innovation and industrial-development programmes Government-supported incubators and technology missions Relevant public-sector and development-finance institutions The employee shall verify the current eligibility, funding structure, application window, eligible expenditure, matching contribution requirements, intellectual-property provisions and milestone requirements of each scheme before recommending it. 2. RDI Fund / ANRF Funding Develop a specialised funding pipeline under the Government's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) framework , including opportunities routed through authorised Second-Level Fund Managers. The position shall: Track RDI funding calls relevant to drones, advanced manufacturing, electronics, AI, robotics and strategic technologies. Identify eligible private-sector, start-up and industry-led projects. Coordinate preparation of technical and financial proposals. Develop project-level funding requirements and milestone plans. Coordinate with authorised Fund Managers and implementing agencies. Maintain documentation required for due diligence and appraisal. Track sanctioned projects, disbursements and utilisation. Ensure that proposals are aligned with the applicable RDI guidelines and financial rules. The RDI Scheme is particularly relevant because the Government has structured it to catalyse private-sector investment in R&D and innovation, with the framework operationalised through ANRF and designated fund managers. R RDI Fund+1 3. Defence Innovation Funding Identify appropriate opportunities under iDEX, TDF and other Ministry of Defence innovation programmes for eligible drone and dual-use technologies. Responsibilities include: Monitoring iDEX challenges and defence problem statements. Identifying technologies suitable for defence applications. Coordinating with start-ups, MSMEs, academia and technology developers. Preparing technical-commercial proposals. Developing milestone-based budgets. Coordinating prototype-development funding. Supporting access to testing facilities and defence users where applicable. Tracking procurement/commercialisation opportunities following successful technology development. iDEX provides funding support for eligible innovation proposals and encourages expenditure on R&D, prototyping, pilot implementation and market assessment. TDF is another relevant channel for indigenous defence technology development, including industry-academia/research-institution collaboration. 4. Government Grant Proposal Development Lead preparation of high-quality funding proposals covering: Executive summary Problem statement Technology description Innovation and technology-readiness level R&D methodology Work packages Project milestones Project implementation schedule Human-resource requirements Capital expenditure R&D expenditure Prototype-development costs Testing and certification costs Manufacturing scale-up requirements Domestic value addition Commercialisation strategy Intellectual-property strategy Market opportunity Employment-generation potential Export potential Strategic relevance Risk analysis Financial projections Funding requirement Co-funding/matching contribution, wherever applicable Expected measurable outcomes 5. Funding Strategy for the Drone Manufacturing Hub Develop a 5 year Government Funding Roadmap for the Hub. The roadmap should identify separate funding requirements for: R&D laboratories Prototype-development facilities Drone testing infrastructure Electronics and avionics development AI/autonomy laboratories Battery and propulsion R&D Manufacturing facilities Common facility centres Certification and compliance infrastructure Start-up incubation Industry-academia collaborative projects Technology commercialisation Defence/dual-use applications Export-oriented manufacturing The manager will create a Scheme-to-Project Matrix showing which Government programme may potentially support each project, subject to the applicable eligibility conditions. 6. Government Liaison and Stakeholder Management Develop and maintain professional relationships with: Central Government Ministries Government departments ANRF DST TDB DRDO/defence innovation ecosystem iDEX/DIO State Government departments Government-supported incubators Universities and IITs/NITs Research institutions Industry associations Start-ups and MSMEs Technology partners Financial institutions Potential co-funding partners All engagement shall be conducted through proper institutional channels and in accordance with applicable Government procedures and organisational policies. 7. IndustryAcademiaGovernment Projects Build consortiums involving: Industry + Start-up/MSME + University/R&D Institution + Government/End User for eligible R&D and innovation programmes. The candidate shall identify complementary capabilities and prepare consortium proposals with clearly defined: Technical responsibilities Financial responsibilities Intellectual-property ownership Technology-transfer arrangements Milestones Deliverables Commercialisation rights Compliance obligations 8. Monitoring and Compliance Maintain a comprehensive database of: Funding schemes Funding calls Application deadlines Eligibility criteria Submitted proposals Sanctioned projects Funding amount Disbursement milestones Utilisation certificates Project milestones Government correspondence Audit requirements Reporting requirements Ensure that no funding claim, eligibility statement or proposal is submitted without verification against the latest applicable Government notification/guidelines. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 The candidate will be evaluated on measurable outcomes such as: Government funding opportunities identified and qualified Number of eligible proposals developed Value of proposals submitted Value of funding sanctioned Number of Government/industry/R&D partnerships established Number of successful R&D projects Number of technologies progressed from prototype to commercialisation Number of start-ups/MSMEs supported Number of industry-academia projects established Funding pipeline value Proposal success/conversion rate Timely submission of applications and reports Compliance with Government funding conditions Important: KPIs shall measure professional activity and actual sanctioned funding, not guarantee that any Government authority will approve a proposal. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Science, Management, Finance, Economics or a related discipline. Master's degree/MBA/M.Tech/PhD or equivalent qualification will be an advantage. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in government funding, R&D grants, technology programmes, business development, project finance, innovation management or institutional fundraising. Experience with Government of India schemes will be strongly preferred. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following: Government R&D grants DST/ANRF programmes TDB programmes Defence innovation programmes iDEX TDF/DRDO ecosystem MSME/start-up funding Technology commercialisation Industry-academia projects Drone/UAV/UAS technology Aerospace Defence technology Electronics AI/robotics Advanced manufacturing Semiconductor/electronics ecosystem Battery/energy technology Essential Skills Government proposal writing Grant writing Project finance Government scheme interpretation Budget preparation Technical proposal development Financial modelling Business-plan preparation Project management Stakeholder management Government correspondence Research and analytical skills Excellent written and verbal communication Presentation skills MS Office/Google Workspace Ability to prepare detailed project reports (DPRs) Desirable Skills Knowledge of: Drone Rules and applicable UAS regulatory framework Drone certification and testing ecosystem Make in India / Atmanirbhar Bharat programmes Government procurement Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) Intellectual-property management Technology transfer Manufacturing value-chain development Defence procurement ecosystem Startup and MSME ecosystem CSR/ESG funding, where legally and operationally applicable Professional Competencies The ideal candidate should demonstrate: Strong Government funding network knowledge High-quality proposal-writing capability Ability to understand complex technical projects Strong financial and commercial understanding Ability to convert technical concepts into fundable projects Strong follow-up and documentation discipline High integrity and compliance orientation Ability to work with senior Government, academic and industry stakeholders Ability to manage multiple funding applications simultaneously 
 Perks and benefits A performance-linked component may be considered based on measurable responsibilities such as proposal development, project mobilisation, partnerships and successful institutional funding outcomes, subject to applicable employment and organisational policies.

Government Funding Identification Continuously identify and track relevant Government of India funding schemes, calls for proposals, grants, soft loans, equity/innovation support, challenge programmes and other eligible financial instruments. RDI Fund / ANRF Funding Develop a specialised funding pipeline under the Government's Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) framework , including opportunities routed through authorised Second-Level Fund Managers. Hands-on experience with at least two agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Microsoft Copilot extensibility.  Role Description 
 The Senior Penetration Tester defines and leads the execution of highly technical and specialized engagements and designs new techniques of testing based on the evolution of industry best practices over time, including emerging areas such as AI and machine learningdriven systems.
 They are both performing hands-on technical testing without requiring supervision and are coordinating teams of testers to ensure that the engagement objectives are met. They strengthen Bookings security posture by proactively identifying vulnerabilities and security control gaps in our systems and applications. The Senior Penetration Tester provides critical input to the Senior Manager - Threat Management with the development of the security assurance strategic plan based on subject matter expertise to increase the impact and value added through this area of focus.
 The Senior Penetration Tester also helps further grow the security assurance area by mentoring other team members and members of other technical non-pentester communities within Booking. The Senior Penetration Tester has strong stakeholder management skills that enable effective communication of technical information to multi-level (up to CISO/CSO level), technical and non-technical audiences both within Booking and the broader Booking Holdings organization.

Owns the design of new technical testing engagements to best serve the current and future needs of the organization, being able to adapt industry best practices to the local technical and cultural environment. Owns the responsibility to ensure that the budget allocated to pentesting activities performed by external vendors, delivers the necessary value and results in a good return on investment. Actively contributes to the mid- and long-term security assurance strategic plan definition by introducing domain expertise insights and ensuring the plan is effective and impactful. title: Digital Analyst - Coveo Administrator
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Owning day-to-day administration of the Coveo platform, including environment configuration, access, pipelines, and governance. Configuring and managing search relevance and merchandising rules (boosting, burying, pinning, synonyms, redirects, triggers, partial-match behavior). Managing query pipelines, ranking strategies, facets, filters, and result behaviors to support business and customer experience objectives. Monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing search performance using Coveo analytics (zero-result queries, engagement, CTR, conversion impact). Partnering with Content, UX/UI, SEO, and Digital Product teams to align search behavior with content strategy and experience design. Collaborating with IT and Architecture teams to support search integrations, indexing accuracy, ingestion stability, and platform health. Working with external partners, including Coveo Customer Success and implementation teams, to resolve issues and drive continuous optimization. Supporting backlog refinement and prioritization for search relevance, merchandising, analytics, and platform enhancements. Writing user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and conducting UAT in agile methodology. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Bachelors or Master’s degree in IT, Digital, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5–7 years of total experience, with minimum 2–3 years in Coveo Administrator role. Hands-on experience with Coveo Search, including merchandising and analytics capabilities (strongly preferred). Strong analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Experience working in global, matrixed organizations. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (verbal and written). Deep understanding of search relevance, taxonomy, and digital merchandising concepts.

AI Architecture & Governance The candidate should understand: Enterprise GenAI architecture AI security and governance Data privacy and access control Prompt and response governance AI observability and monitoring Human-in-the-loop mechanisms Responsible AI principles Model and prompt evaluation Data classification and protection Cost and performance optimization for GenAI applications Preferred Certifications Candidates with the following certifications will be preferred: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator ( CSA ) ServiceNow Certified Application Developer ( CAD ) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist ( CIS ) ServiceNow AI / GenAI-related certifications ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect ( CTA ) – highly desirable Relevant cloud AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Preferred Experience Experience implementing enterprise GenAI use cases . Experience with ServiceNow Now Assist implementations. Experience building AI-powered ServiceNow workflows and automation. Experience with RAG-based enterprise applications. Experience integrating ServiceNow with LLM platforms. Experience with AI Agents / Agentic workflows. Experience conducting GenAI POCs and converting them into production solutions. Experience working with large enterprise ServiceNow environments. Soft Skills Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. Strong solution-design and architectural thinking. Ability to communicate complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to lead technical discussions and architecture reviews. Strong documentation and presentation skills. Ability to mentor developers and technical teams. Business-oriented approach to identifying practical AI use cases. Experience 5–15 years of overall IT experience , with significant experience in ServiceNow and AI/GenAI technologies . Candidates with a combination of ServiceNow Architect/Developer experience + hands-on GenAI implementation experience will be strongly preferred. Interview Details Interview Mode: Face-to-Face (F2F)

title: Manager Instrumentation Project with India's leading industrial house
description:
Greetings! & very warm welcome to BEST-FIT Recruitment Riders, 
 We are BEST-FIT Recruitment Riders feel immense pleasure to search and provide you with better carrier opportunities to aid you in achieving your aspirations. BEST-FIT Recruitment Rider is a highly specialized Recruitment & Executive Search Partner for Pharmaceutical, Biotech, CRO, Chemicals, Medical Devices & Turnkey Pharma Projects Engineering-Construction Design Sectors. We are searching & recruiting highly qualified professionals for Middle-Senior-Upper-Management and Executive jobs. (Eg: Managers, VP, President, CFO & CEO). Also offering customized recruitment services by Headhunting & Executive Search for Middle & Top management level professionals according to clients specific needs. We are BEST-FIT Recruitment Riders do exactly what our name tells. To know more about us please visit our website: www.bestfitrecruitment.co.in We would like to inform you that presently we have professional career opportunity matching to your profile with one of our esteemed client. 
 Please see the following position summary: 
 Client: Indias leading industrial house Position: Manager - Electrical & Instrumentation Projects Job Location: Saykha, Bharuch, Vadodara Facilities: Transportation + Canteen Bus Route: Ankleswar Bharuch Saykha Plant 
 Purpose of Job: The E&I Projects Manager will be responsible for planning, execution, commissioning, maintenance, reliability, compliance and documentation of electrical and instrumentation systems across the plant. The position will lead the E&I team and coordinate with Projects, Production, QA/QC, EHS, Procurement, Vendors and Contractors to ensure safe, reliable and timely completion of projects and maintenance activities. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable statutory requirements, electrical safety regulations, hazardous-area requirements, ISO management systems and company engineering standards. 

 Role & responsibilities 1. E&I Project Planning & Execution: Plan, execute and monitor electrical and instrumentation projects from conceptualization through commissioning and handover. Prepare project schedules, manpower plans, material requirements and execution strategies. Review electrical and instrumentation design, engineering drawings, specifications, BOQs, datasheets and technical documents. Coordinate with consultants, contractors, vendors and internal departments for timely project execution. Supervise installation, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of electrical and instrumentation equipment. Ensure projects are completed within approved budget, timeline, quality and safety requirements. Conduct site inspections and monitor contractor performance and work quality. Review and approve relevant technical documents, drawings, method statements and commissioning procedures. Ensure proper project handover along with as-built drawings, manuals, test reports and other technical documentation. 
 2. E&I Team Leadership: Lead and supervise the E&I team, including engineers, technicians and contractors. Allocate jobs, assign responsibilities and monitor individual/team performance. Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to the E&I team. Develop manpower deployment plans according to project and maintenance requirements. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify training and competency-development requirements. Promote a strong culture of safety, discipline, teamwork and continuous improvement. 
 3. Preventive & Corrective Maintenance Plan and oversee preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance of electrical and instrumentation systems. Ensure minimum equipment downtime and quick restoration during electrical/instrumentation breakdowns. Monitor system performance, equipment health and reliability. Develop and periodically review preventive maintenance schedules. Analyse recurring failures and implement Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective/Preventive Actions (CAPA). Ensure proper maintenance of electrical panels, MCCs, PCCs, transformers, DG systems, UPS, batteries, motors, drives, PLC/DCS/SCADA systems, control valves, field instruments and associated systems. 
 4. Engineering Documentation & Controlled Documents Responsible for preparation, issuance, review and control of applicable E&I technical and maintenance documents, including: Analytical / technical protocols, wherever applicable. SOPs and work instructions. Equipment logbooks. Maintenance formats and checklists. Equipment and system specifications. Testing and commissioning protocols. Preventive Maintenance schedules. Calibration schedules. Training calendars and training records. Equipment history cards and maintenance records. Electrical and instrumentation drawings and documentation. As-built drawings and technical manuals. Ensure all documents are properly controlled, updated and readily available for audits and inspections. 
 5. Calibration & Instrumentation Management Develop and maintain the annual calibration schedule for critical instrumentation. Ensure timely calibration of process instruments, measuring instruments and control systems. Coordinate with approved external calibration agencies wherever required. Review calibration certificates and ensure traceability of measuring equipment. Monitor out-of-calibration conditions and initiate appropriate corrective actions. Maintain calibration records and documentation for statutory, quality and audit requirements. 
 6. SOP, ISO & Management-System Compliance Prepare, review and periodically update E&I-related SOPs, work instructions, formats and procedures. Support implementation and maintenance of: ISO 9001:2015-Quality Management System, ISO 14001:2015-Environmental Management System, ISO 45001:2018-Occupational Health & Safety Management System Ensure E&I documentation is compliant with applicable ISO requirements. Participate in internal and external audits and close audit observations within defined timelines. Ensure proper document control, record retention and traceability. 
 7. Statutory & Electrical Compliance Ensure compliance with applicable local electrical laws, statutory requirements and regulatory authorities. Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety requirements and hazardous-area requirements. Maintain statutory electrical inspection and compliance records. Coordinate statutory inspections, testing and certification wherever applicable. Ensure electrical installations, equipment and systems are maintained in accordance with applicable standards. Ensure appropriate compliance with recognized engineering standards such as IEC, IEEE and relevant Indian Standards/IS requirements, as applicable. Maintain compliance documentation for audits and inspections. 
 8. Electrical Safety & Hazardous Area Management Implement safe working practices for electrical and instrumentation activities. Ensure compliance with electrical isolation, LOTO, PTW and other plant safety procedures. Ensure proper maintenance and inspection of electrical installations in hazardous areas. Participate in electrical safety audits, risk assessments, HAZOP/HAZID studies and other safety assessments as applicable. Identify electrical and instrumentation-related hazards and implement suitable control measures. Conduct/coordinate safety training and toolbox talks for E&I employees and contractors. Ensure proper PPE usage and safe working practices during E&I activities. 
 9. Power & Energy Management Prepare and maintain daily power consumption reports. Monitor plant-wise/area-wise electricity consumption and major electrical loads. Track energy consumption trends and identify abnormal consumption. Identify opportunities for energy conservation and efficiency improvement. Support energy audits and implementation of energy-saving projects. Monitor power factor, demand, load utilization and other relevant electrical parameters. Prepare periodic energy-performance reports for management review. 
 10. Monitoring, Reporting & MIS Maintain daily E&I maintenance and project logs. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly maintenance reports. Track equipment breakdowns and downtime. Prepare breakdown analysis and reliability reports. Monitor PM compliance and pending maintenance activities. Prepare project progress reports and highlight delays, risks and critical issues. Maintain KPI/MIS reports related to E&I maintenance, projects, energy consumption and equipment reliability. 
 11. Inventory & Spare Parts Management Maintain adequate inventory of critical electrical and instrumentation spare parts. Identify critical and insurance spares based on equipment criticality and failure history. Monitor minimum/maximum stock levels. Raise purchase/requisition requests for required materials and spares. Coordinate with Procurement and Stores for timely availability of critical components. Review technical specifications of electrical and instrumentation materials before procurement. Control obsolete and slow-moving spares and optimize inventory costs. 
 12. Budget & Cost Management Prepare and manage the E&I departmental/project budget. Monitor maintenance and project expenditure against approved budgets. Control maintenance costs without compromising safety, quality and reliability. Optimize manpower, contractor utilization, materials and resources. Identify cost-saving and value-engineering opportunities. Support procurement of electrical and instrumentation equipment, systems, services and spares. Evaluate technical quotations and participate in vendor/contractor technical discussions. 
 13. Technical Documentation & Records Maintain updated electrical and instrumentation drawings, layouts, schematics, datasheets and technical records. Ensure availability of equipment manuals, test reports, calibration certificates and commissioning records. Maintain proper records of maintenance, breakdowns, modifications and project activities. Ensure all modifications are properly documented through approved change-control procedures. Prepare technical reports for management, audits and statutory inspections. 
 14. Reliability & Continuous Improvement Drive improvement initiatives to enhance equipment reliability and plant availability. Conduct RCA for major and repetitive electrical/instrumentation failures. Identify opportunities for automation, instrumentation improvement and process optimization. Evaluate obsolete equipment and recommend replacement/upgrade strategies. Implement condition-monitoring and predictive-maintenance practices wherever feasible. Benchmark maintenance practices and introduce best engineering practices. 

 Preferred candidate profile B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering / Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering / Instrumentation Engineering. Diploma in Electrical / Instrumentation Engineering with strong relevant industrial experience may also be considered. Additional certification in electrical safety, project management, energy management or industrial automation will be an advantage. 815 years of relevant experience in Electrical & Instrumentation Engineering, Projects and Maintenance. Preference for candidates with experience in chemical, specialty chemical, pharmaceutical, API, manufacturing or process industries. Experience in plant/project execution, commissioning and maintenance is preferred. Experience in handling E&I contractors, vendors and multidisciplinary project teams. Working knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 systems is preferred. Experience in hazardous-area installations and statutory electrical compliance will be an added advantage. 
 The candidate should preferably have hands-on experience with some/all of the following: 
 HT/LT electrical systems, Transformers, HT/LT Panels, PCC, MCC and distribution systems DG Sets and synchronization systems, UPS and battery systems, PLC / DCS / SCADA systems Motors and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Industrial instrumentation and control systems Control valves and actuators, Process transmitters and analyzers Fire & Gas systems, wherever applicable Earthing and lightning protection systems Hazardous-area electrical/instrumentation installations Cable laying, termination and testing, Electrical protection systems Instrumentation calibration systems, Plant utility electrical systems 
 Skills & Competencies: Strong knowledge of electrical and instrumentation systems. Project planning and execution skills. Strong troubleshooting and analytical ability. Team leadership and manpower management. Vendor and contractor management. Budget and cost-control capability. Good knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance. Strong documentation and reporting skills. Knowledge of electrical safety and hazardous-area requirements. Knowledge of PLC/DCS/SCADA and industrial automation. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities. Strong focus on safety, compliance, reliability and continuous improvement.
